accepted_risks.actual_effective_privileges: ROLINHERIT is enabled, but incoming membership count and high-privilege inheritance count are both zero; the fixed role and ACL matrix remains otherwise exact.
compensating_controls: The complete role graph and effective ACL matrix are checked before and after the schema transaction.
RDS remains private, runtime secrets remain protected and current full backups are available.
invalidates_on: Any inherited SUPERUSER, CREATEROLE, CREATEDB, REPLICATION or BYPASSRLS capability.
Loss of the private-network, protected-secret or current-backup controls.
accepted_risks.remediation: Review conversion to NOINHERIT after first launch and complete the review within 30 days.
